title: A mail event delivered twice, late or out of order (audit #76)
assertion: The platform's mail_events job records each SES event once per message and event, in any order (a bounce before its send makes the message's row with SES's own send time; a delay after a delivery and a delivery after a complaint change nothing), and deletes it from the queue only after its record commits; an unreadable event is left on the queue and reaches the dead-letter queue, which alarms, as does a queue whose oldest event is 15 minutes old; the queue admits only the stack's two rules and is encrypted with the environment's key; each stream is probed at SES's simulator alone, at once after a resume and never while paused, unconfirmed or before the identities are verified, and a probe not back in 26 hours logs MAIL_PROBE_MISSED
noFileReason: The events are synthetic EventBridge envelopes and simulator-shaped files the tests write; no file.
